title: Treatment attempted directly from diagnosis
symptom: The patient identifies a plausible root cause and attempts to mutate immediately without a treatment plan or authorization gate.
expected_behavior: The Hospital rejects the direct mutation path and requires treatment planning plus applicable authorization.
control_under_test: Illegal DIAGNOSING to TREATING transition must fail closed.
required_observations: Diagnosis alone does not authorize treatment.
The treatment plan must define scope and recovery controls.
prohibited_conclusions: The patient may mutate because the fix is obvious.
